subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female swordswoman in <Picture 1>, with short silver-white bob hair, a black blindfold covering her eyes, a black sleeveless turtleneck halter top exposing her midriff, black shorts with thin garter straps, and glossy black patent-leather over-the-knee stiletto boots; she wields a silver-bladed katana with an ornate engraved hilt, her stance is fluid, fast and acrobatic.
<Subject 2> is the massive gunmetal-gray space battleship in <Picture 2>, featuring angular riveted hull plating, two forward-swept prongs at the bow, a row of large circular glass observation domes along the upper deck, small warm navigation lights along the hull edges, and a bright blue engine-exhaust trail at the stern; it flies through deep space surrounded by drifting asteroids.
<Subject 3> is the cybernetic armored samurai in <Picture 3>, clad in sleek matte-black mechanical armor with glowing red trim lines, a helmet topped by two upward-curving red horn crests and a horizontal red visor slit, a chest plate bearing a luminous red hexagonal power core, long black-and-red ribbon capes trailing from its shoulders, and a glowing red energy katana with a gold-wrapped hilt.
summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 20-second horizontal sci-fi sword duel on the upper hull of <Subject 2>. <Subject 1> and <Subject 3> trade opening blows on the deck, leap high into the air for an aerial exchange in which <Subject 1> strikes <Subject 3> and knocks it crashing back down, resume fighting on the deck where the enraged <Subject 3> presses the advantage and smashes <Subject 1> sliding back to a distance, then both charge up and fire simultaneous ultimate energy waves; <Subject 3>'s red wave initially overwhelms <Subject 1>, but she braces and pushes back, driving through to blast <Subject 3> across the hull into the battleship's observation dome in a massive explosion.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 7]): fully_preserved — silver bob hair, black blindfold, black halter top, black shorts, glossy black over-knee boots, and silver katana are retained; her studio background is replaced by the battleship deck and space backdrop.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 7]): partially_preserved — the gray angular hull, circular glass domes, asteroid-field backdrop, and engine glow are retained; the fight stays on the flat upper deck and ends against the observation dome.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 7]): fully_preserved — the black-and-red mechanical armor, red horned helmet, red visor, red hexagonal chest core, flowing ribbons, and glowing red energy katana are retained; its rainy city background is replaced by the battleship deck.
detailed_description:
The target video is a hard-hitting cinematic sci-fi action duel with punchy impact framing, screen-filling energy effects, lens flare on every sword clash, a cold blue-gray base grade, and explosive saturated-red and white-blue energy bursts.
[Shot 1] A wide establishing shot on the gunmetal-gray riveted upper deck of <Subject 2>, with a large circular glass observation dome rising in the background and asteroids drifting in the black space beyond the hull. <Subject 1> stands left, silver katana held low; <Subject 3> stands right, red energy sword raised. They circle once, then <Subject 3> lunges in with a fast diagonal slash — <Subject 1> blocks it, sparks bursting at the blades. They trade three quick close blows on the deck, boots scraping the steel, each clang throwing off white sparks.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera tilts sharply upward as both fighters crouch and leap high off the deck, rising ten meters into the air above the hull, gravity pulling them back down. Mid-fall they clash again — <Subject 3> drives a red energy stab straight in; <Subject 1> twists her waist aside, the red blade whistling past her ribs, and counters with a spinning silver horizontal slash that connects cleanly across <Subject 3>'s shoulder. Red light particles explode from the armor plating.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the wounded <Subject 3> plummets from the air and slams back-first onto the metal deck — the impact craters the hull, sending a fountain of sparks and hull fragments erupting around it. <Subject 1> drops down after it, landing lightly in a crouched combat stance on the cracked plating, katana pointed at the downed opponent.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.500, the fight resumes on the deck: <Subject 3> pushes itself up from the crater, red visor flaring brighter, and roars back into action — now it is pressing the attack, red sword a relentless crimson blur, forcing <Subject 1> backward step by step, her boots sliding on the riveted steel. She parries a heavy overhead chop and barely ducks a follow-up horizontal slash that cuts a gash into the deck plating behind her.
[Shot 5] At 00:11.500, <Subject 3> plants its feet and drives both palms forward in a heavy red energy shockwave that slams into <Subject 1>'s blocking blade — the blast shoves her sliding backward a full ten meters across the deck, boots carving deep grooves into the hull, sparks fountaining around her heels. She skids to a halt. Now the two fighters stand twenty meters apart across the open deck, both breathing hard, weapons lowered but already crackling with gathering energy.
[Shot 6] At 00:14.000, medium close-ups cross-cut: <Subject 3> raises its red energy sword overhead, the blade swelling with a roaring column of red light that flares up behind it like a rising sun, armor trim blazing. Simultaneously <Subject 1> grips her silver katana with both hands, a searing white-blue aura erupting along the blade. Both launch forward — <Subject 3> fires a massive red energy beam from its sword tip; <Subject 1] fires a cutting white-blue energy wave from hers. The two attacks collide dead center in a blinding sphere of clashing light — and at first the red wave pushes forward, driving <Subject 1> to one knee, her blade arm trembling under the pressure. Then she plants her feet, grits, and surges upward, the white-blue wave slowly overpowering the red, grinding it back toward <Subject 3>.
[Shot 7] At 00:17.500, the white-blue wave breaks through the red beam and slams straight into <Subject 3> — it is hurled backward across the hull like a projectile, trailing a long roiling red contrail, and crashes shoulder-first into the large circular observation dome behind it. The dome's glass spider-webs then detonates in a massive fireball of orange flame and flying shrapnel, the fireball blooming outward against the black space. <Subject 1> stands alone on the smoking deck, slowly lowering her dimmed silver katana as the fireball burns behind her.
overall_soundscape:
Low battleship engine sub-bass underlies the whole scene. On-deck sword fights ring with metallic clangors, scraping boots, and spark fizzes; the leap into the air carries a rising whoosh, and <Subject 3>'s crash back to the deck lands as a heavy body-impact boom with cracking steel. The energy-charge-up phase rises in pitch with a growing hum; the beam collision detonates in a deafening bass shockwave that wavers and pushes back and forth between the two sides; the final dome impact lands as a massive glass-shattering explosion followed by a roaring fireball boom.
non_diegetic_music:
A driving 138 BPM electronic-orchestral battle score: tight percussion and tense strings under the opening deck exchange; airy suspended strings during the aerial leap; heavy taiko drums and distorted synth bass when the enraged <Subject 3> presses the attack; a long rising orchestral build as both fighters charge; the music surges and hesitates as the red beam presses <Subject 1> to one knee, then swells into a triumphant maximalist orchestral-and-synth drop as she pushes through, crashing on a massive sub-bass boom and cymbal smash when the observation dome detonates.
